root_cause: The 'Download OpenVINO artifacts (tests)' step (akashchi/download-artifact action) repeatedly timed out calling the GitHub Actions ArtifactService ListArtifacts twirp RPC, exhausting all 5 retry attempts. Immediately afterwards the same job also failed to resolve 'github.com' from DNS during post-job git cleanup, indicating a transient networking/DNS outage on the runner or in GitHub's Actions backend rather than any problem with the PR's code change (the PR only removes an unused member variable in a CPU emitter header, unrelated to artifact handling).
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; this is a transient GitHub Actions infrastructure/networking issue tied to the specific runner and timing of this run.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Python API tests - Python 3.11' job (and the dependent overall-status job) - a retry is expected to succeed since the PR's diff is unrelated to artifact handling.
If the ArtifactService timeout or DNS resolution failures recur across multiple PRs within a short window, escalate to GitHub Support / check the GitHub Status page for Actions service incidents.
prevention_strategies: No code-side prevention is possible for transient GitHub infrastructure outages. Consider enabling automatic rerun-on-transient-failure via the workflow rerunner for ArtifactService timeout signatures (see rerun_search_string proposal) to reduce merge-queue friction from this class of failure.
historical_context: Similar ArtifactService/artifact-download infrastructure failures have been seen before with different error text (ECONNREFUSED, 403 Forbidden, blob storage chunk timeout - patterns 1808e665f1f70825, 3a6ca31c39b0147d, 94ac5e158bc45b5a, b889d24cd154d2dd, bd5ee42b01f94f83), but this exact 'Request timeout' twirp RPC signature is new and has not been recorded before in this database.
